---
★ Request
Wipe
Phew, that was brutal~!

Waah~! Of course! A halvsies buddy like you is
well-welcome anytime! Looking forward to working with you!

*gasp*, *pant*... W-We're going again alreadyyy?!
No wayyy...!

Oh, right, Trainer!
Umm, could you maybe give me some advice?

Keep up, keep up, gotta... kee—urk...!
Yaaah, I'm completely out of gas...!

Hey, haven't Rice and the others been at it for over 2 hours?
Interval training, was it...? Both of them are incredible.

Come on, you stayed right on their heels until the last 300 meters.
That's plenty impressive on its own.

Incredibly positive, hardworking, and possessing solid natural grit.
Just watching her over the past few days told me everything about her character.

Taiyaki, taiyaki! Who wants fresh taiyaki~?
Only one left!

My goal for this month is "Build That Stamina!",
so I really want to train up my slow-twitch muscles!

Set three. Adding 200 meters.
...Hup!

Mihono Bourbon's hardcore training was among the toughest in the academy.
In fact, most Umamusume tapped out after the first set, but—

Well, um, I'm still nowhere near good enough to take on the top tier,
and I'm not really built for reckless, crazy training either.

Ahaha, I'm fine, totally fine!
My legs are just trembling a bit. ...Still a long way to go, huh~.

Steamed pork buns, hot steamed pork buns~!
Only one left, folks~!

She wasn't the flashy, standout type.
Yet, depending on her growth, she seemed full of latent potential.
? Is something the matter?

So, I figure I'll just take it step by step with what I can do~!
If I keep at it, I know I'll be able to win someday!
As we kept having little encounters like that—

And so began my days with Machikane Tannhauser—
a girl who was delightfully "ordinary," yet delightfully quirky.
A few days after that happened.

We began exchanging small talk whenever we passed each other on campus.
Then, one day.

While the other Umamusume slumped in defeat, Machikane Tannhauser
kept pushing forward, tackling the slope for a second set despite falling behind.

Maybe I should add more stamina work.
I also wanna practice a low-drag running form... *huff*.

No way, that was plenty awesome.
Nice fight, Machitan.
I-I won't give up either~!

...Gasp!
Waargh! I-I'm so sorry! Please, go right ahead, take it!

Oh my goodness~, what are the odds?
...Wanna go halvsies again today? Heheh.

No, no, we called it at the exact same time!
...Ah! I know!

...Huh?!
Waargh! I'm so sor—wait, WHAAA?! It's you!

This has gotta be fate.
See you around sometime!

Still, I feel like I'm getting the hang of long-distance running, yep!
It was great training! Better jot it down before I forget...

Aw shucks, not really. Ugh...
—Wait, whoa! You're that person from before!

Slope dash set one complete.
Proceeding to set two.

Aw man, you saw me look totally pathetic.
I really wanted to keep up till the very end, though. Ehehe.

A contract?
............Ah, wait, are you making me an offer?!

No problem at all, sharing always makes food taste better anyway!
So you were a Trainer here at the academy after all, huh?
Are you alright?

*whew*, *pant*, *haaah*... Aaah, I couldn't finish the third set~.
Bourbon really is something else, huh—whoa, whoa!
Hehehe. ~.

Ah, !
Oh yeah, oh yeah! Look at this, look at this photo!

Glancing at the notebook she handed over... I saw a fairly demanding
independent training routine neatly mapped out day by day.

I caaaan't... do it...! *haaah*...!
...Ugh, and here I thought my stamina was getting pretty solid, too.

Ehehe, guess what... I snagged a brand-new
spider plushie! It's just the absolute cutest thing!
One taiyaki, please~!
*pant*, *gasp*, *pant*...!

*pant*, *huff*, *pant*~...
No good~! And here I had decent confidence in my stamina, too.
A few days after that day.

Led by Mihono Bourbon,
several Umamusume were conducting joint slope training.

Mmm, piping hot, delightfully chewy, and berry delicious~.
Thanks for the treat!
*pant*, *gasp*, *whew*, *pant*!
One steamed pork bun, please~!
